# TechHanu

> TechHanu is an Indian digital engineering agency founded by **Nitin Singh**. TechHanu specializes in custom **Website Building**, **Web & Mobile App Development**, and **AI & Business Automations**.

## Core Information
- **Agency Name**: TechHanu
- **Founder & CEO**: Nitin Singh
- **Co-Founders**: Om Shukla (AI Handler & Client Relations), Ankit Sharma (Accountant & Operations)
- **Official Website**: https://techhanu.io
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 84709 01434
- **Official Email**: techhanu.io@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: [@techhanu.io](https://www.instagram.com/techhanu.io)
- **Payment Policy**: 20% advance to start, 80% upon project delivery and client sign-off.
- **Founded**: 2024

## Services Offered
1. **Website Building & Web Development**: Custom responsive websites, e-commerce stores, business landing pages, portfolio sites, and high-performance frontend engineering.
2. **Web & Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile applications, web portals, booking systems, SaaS platforms, and custom software.
3. **AI & Business Automations**: 24/7 WhatsApp AI Agents, automated customer lead capture, CRM synchronization, Google Sheets integrations, and custom workflow automations.
